# book_feedback (Resource)

The feedback records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `message` (String) Feedback message
- `object_id` (String) Object the feedback applies to
- `object_type` (String) Object type the feedback applies to

### Optional

- `bookable_id` (String) The key of the bookable record.
- `bookable_type_id` (String) The key of the bookable_type record.
- `booking_id` (String) The key of the booking record.
- `calendar_plan_id` (String) The key of the calendar_plan record.
- `code_id` (String) The key of the code record.
- `rating` (Number) Optional numeric rating
- `user_id` (String)
